subject: Secure SDLC evidence matrix + CI credential walkthrough
messages:
From: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@secureassess.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood-inference.com
Cc: procurement@greenline-fin.com
Date: 2025-08-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SDLC evidence matrix + CI credential access for SOC2 assessor

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for agreeing to help Greenline Financial's assessment team. To kick off the evidence collection for the SDLC portion of the SOC2/SIG intake, could you provide the following: 1) completed evidence matrix (attached template), 2) a small, redacted sample of CI logs showing PR gating and pipeline approvals, 3) a code review sample that demonstrates review comments and approvals.

We'd also like to schedule a short (30–45m) walkthrough of the CI/CD flow and secrets management so our assessor can clarify items before the formal intake. Prefer week of Aug 25—do you have availability?

Itemized asks: 
- Evidence matrix (code review, CI gates, secrets handling, change approval)
- Sample CI logs (redacted tokens/IDs acceptable)
- Pointer to runbook or change-change approval policy (URL or doc)
- A named contact for the live walkthrough and their role

If you can attach the matrix and one sample artifact in reply that will speed things up. We understand some items will be redacted or provided under an NDA — happy to sign one if needed.

Best,
Emma
Emma Jenkins
Senior Assessor, SecureAssess
emma.jenkins@secureassess.com
+1 415 555 0142

Attachment: evidence_matrix_template.xlsx (please populate)

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood-inference.com>
To: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@secureassess.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2025-08-19T13:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence matrix + CI credential access for SOC2 assessor

Emma — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to help and can provide the matrix plus redacted artifacts. Looping in Marissa (Security & Compliance) and Ben (Eng manager) to coordinate the artifacts and the walkthrough.

Quick answers:
- Matrix: we'll use your template and return a populated copy by EOD Aug 21.
- CI logs: we'll export a redacted pipeline run and remove any user tokens/identifiers; target size ~5MB.
- Code review sample: we'll include a PR thread showing comments, reviewer approvals, and merge timestamp (redacted by reviewer email).
- Runbook/policy: Marissa will point to the internal change policy doc and share a read-only Drive link.

For the walkthrough: Ben can present the CI gating and ephemeral credential flow. Proposed slots (PST): Aug 26 10:00–10:45, Aug 27 14:00–14:45. Let us know which works.

We do have an assessor NDA template if needed — otherwise we can exchange redacted artifacts first and escalate any requests for unredacted logs through procurement.

Attaching: evidence_matrix_template.xlsx (populating now), sample placeholders: ci_logs_redacted.zip (will follow), code_review_sample.patch (will follow).

Cheers,
Avery Johnson
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood-inference.com
+1 650 555 0199

Attachments: evidence_matrix_template.xlsx (blank copy attached)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood-inference.com>, Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@secureassess.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2025-08-20T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence matrix + CI credential access for SOC2 assessor

Hi Emma / team — waving in as the security lead on the SDLC intake. Thanks for the ask, Avery.

I've started populating the matrix and attached a redacted CI run export (ci_logs_redacted.zip). Notes on redactions: user emails have been obfuscated to user_###, tokens removed, and exact artifact checksums replaced with placeholders. The code_review_sample.patch contains a small PR with three review comments and an approval by reviewer_user_12; internal IDs are redacted.

Pointers:
- Change management runbook (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-evidence-pack (access granted to emma.jenkins@secureassess.com)
- CI gating: we enforce branch protection + required approvals + OPA policy gates in pipeline.
- Secrets handling: ephemeral vault (short-lived tokens) with automated rotation; we do not store long-lived plaintext secrets in repo. See doc section 3.2 in runbook.

For the walkthrough, Ben will demo the PR -> pipeline flow and show how the ephemeral token lifecycle works end-to-end. Ben, please confirm the Aug 26 10:00 PST slot or suggest alternates.

If you need a signed NDA before we provide unredacted logs, say the word and procurement can initiate.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com

Attachments: ci_logs_redacted.zip, code_review_sample.patch

From: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@secureassess.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: procurement@greenline-fin.com
Date: 2025-08-22T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence matrix + CI credential access for SOC2 assessor

Marissa / Avery — received, thank you. The redaction approach looks good; I was able to open the Drive link and saw the runbook section you referenced.

We'd like to move ahead with the walkthrough on Aug 26 10:00 PST. Please invite the Zoom link below and add the assessor (Tariq Hassan, tariq.hassan@secureassess.com) as a participant. Also, Greenline procurement routed an NDA for non-redacted artifacts — see DocuSign link. We can keep the initial review scoped to redacted artifacts and request unredacted logs only after the NDA is in place.
